text: {"observations": [{"unit_ids": ["D6a5792ae52.P008.S001"], "anchor": null, "reason": "Does strengthening anti-fraud safeguards and illicit-finance detection reduce criminal exploitation of financial institutions?"},{"unit_ids": ["D6a5792ae52.P010.S001", "D6a5792ae52.P010.S002"], "anchor": null, "reason": "Does issuing red-flag guidance on payroll fraud and shell companies improve suspicious activity reporting by banks?"},{"unit_ids": ["D6a5792ae52.P018.S002"], "anchor": "FinCEN is rolling out updated guidance that enables financial institutions to share information about fraud in real time, and in closer coordination with one another.", "reason": "Does enabling real-time inter-institution fraud information sharing reduce illicit financial activity?"},{"unit_ids": ["D6a5792ae52.P022.S002"], "anchor": "Our objective is not to burden community banks with unnecessary requirements, but to provide a regulatory framework that allows institutions to focus resources where the risks are greatest.", "reason": "Does risk-targeted bank compliance regulation improve detection efficiency while reducing compliance costs?"}]}
